convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom for X2MACandle indicator which is a custom .ex5 indicator not available as builtin; also uses martingale recovery money management which adds complexity

derived_values.name: X2MACandle candle color
derived_values.formula: Fast_MA vs Slow_MA relationship encoded as candle color (bullish=Fast>Slow, bearish=Fast<Slow)

other_exits: Close opposite position on signal reversal before opening new position

position_sizing.conditional_logic: Base lot used after win; lot multiplied by RecoveryCoeff after each consecutive loss, resets to base lot after a win; negative MM lots = fixed lots, positive MM lots = deposit fraction

custom_logic_notes: MMRec (Money Management Recovery) is a martingale-type system: after a losing trade, lot size is increased by RecoveryCoeff multiplier to recover losses; after a winning trade, lot size resets to base. The EA closes opposite positions on signal reversal before opening new ones. X2MACandle is a custom indicator showing two MAs as candlestick bars where color changes indicate MA crossovers. SL/TP values are adjusted for 5-digit brokers by multiplying by 10 when _Digits==5 or _Point<0.001.
python_conversion_notes: The X2MACandle custom indicator must be reimplemented in Python as it is not a standard builtin indicator - it encodes two MA crossover states as candlestick colors. The MMRec martingale recovery system needs careful implementation: track consecutive losses, multiply lots by recovery coefficient on loss, reset on win. The position_gate logic (close opposite before entering) must be implemented as a pre-trade check. Digit adjustment for SL/TP on 5-digit brokers is critical. Since this uses on_bar logic with new_bar_guard, the Python version should use bar-close event processing rather than tick-by-tick.
